snippet.title: Eternals' Path - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Eternals' Path is a 2D turn-based rogue-like RPG about reincarnation and past-lives choices, in a colorful and mysterious Afterlife. 
During your journey, you'll meet people you once knew, talk with them and repent from past mistakes, or on the contrary, face them and impose your version of the facts. Narration is tied with the gameplay, with dialogues impacting the upcoming fights, as well as your statistics! Manage your Humanity as a double-edged sword, both a ressource and a weapon. Gather Memories from past lives, and craft a unique build with more than 20 skills to unlock. And finally, escape towards your reincarnation ! 

🌀 Demo on PC coming 9th of June 2025 on Steam.
WISHLIST on Steam: bit.ly/EternalsPath

💚 To support us : 
KICKSTARTER Campaign from 09.06 until 09.07 2025 : https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sleeplessparadise/eternals-path

⛅Follow us and stay up-to-date with Eternals' Path !
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sleeplessparadise_games/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@sleeplessparadisegames
Official Website: https://sleeplessparadise.com/
Links : linktr.ee/sleeplessparadise

Special thanks to Bastien Martins (aka @LeTropeur ) for his voice-acting, and to Vincent Schaerer for his amazing music !
